{{Infobox auto}}

'''Cooked mutton''' is cooked meat. Like all meat in Matcha Flavoured, it has no [[intrinsic]]: it heals {{Value|Cooked Mutton|heals}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_mutton.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw mutton cooks in an [[oven]] in {{Value|Cooked Mutton|cook_time|station=Oven}} or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Cooked Mutton|cook_time|station=Kindling}}. The vanilla recipes are replaced, and in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] it becomes [[Charred Meat|charred meat]] instead.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Cooked Mutton|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Cooked Mutton|heals}}.

Cooked mutton can top a [[Pizza|meat pizza]]. Raw mutton goes into [[Curry Stock|curry stock]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Raw Mutton ==
{{Vanilla|Raw Mutton}}
'''Raw Mutton''' is dropped by animals as in vanilla. It keeps its vanilla food values and doesn't heal.
{{Uses|Raw Mutton}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer made meat plain so that players have less reason to build animal farms: "since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=And since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses.}}</ref>
